title: When a phone does not arrive
breadcrumb: When a phone does not arrive

slides.title: See what happened
slides.html: A phone that was refused or failed shows in red, with the reason. The count says how many failed.

slides.title: Read the details
slides.html: Double-click the phone, or select it and press Details: the reason in full, and whether enrolment is still open.

slides.title: Fix the cause
slides.html: Callsign taken or not allowed: give another. Enrolment closed, or your MDM has an old challenge: open enrolment and press Open in the MDM connector again.

slides.title: Could not reach Deploy App
slides.html: The phone could not reach Deploy App's address when it asked. Check its network, then press Ask again.

slides.title: Enrolment has closed
slides.html: The line turns amber ten minutes before closing, and red after. Open Deploy App ↗ takes you to the MDM page to open enrolment again.

slides.title: Ask again
slides.html: Once the cause is fixed, select the phone and press Ask again. Refused or failed selects them all.

slides.title: Or give another callsign
slides.html: A taken callsign is never freed. In the phone's details press Give another callsign, and give it a new one.

slides.title: Never swap the certificate
slides.html: With Fleet, do not replace the team's certificate to retry: every phone in the team would lose its own.

slides.title: The token stopped working
slides.html: When your MDM no longer accepts the token, the connector asks for a new one by itself, with the MDM's reason. Paste a new token and press Connect.

slides.title: Certificate Authentication Failed
slides.html: The phone has its certificate, but Chrome's policy for it was overwritten. Send the policy again (see From the command line, or without the connector Name phones in Fleet without the connector), then open Deploy App again.
